name: Avaceratops
sum: Avaceratops is a small ceratopsid from the Campanian Judith River Formation of Montana, based on a juvenile or subadult skeleton.
wsnote: 2.3 m for the holotype, 4.2 m suggested by a second skull (MOR 692), and about one tonne for a four-metre animal (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: ANSP 15800, a partial skeleton with lower skull, left lower jaw, vertebrae, shoulder girdle and limb elements — Judith River Formation, Montana; probably a juvenile or subadult.
material: A second skull with nose and brow horns (MOR 692) that may not belong to the genus.
biology: Postorbital horn cores of the new skull are 25 cm long.
author: Dodson 1986
